notes.title: Huddle Genius – Version 1.01u Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.01u is now live and addresses a couple of important issues:

🛠 Critical Fix

Resolved a crash caused by CSV files not being read properly. Your exposure imports should now load smoothly without errors.

⚡ Feature Adjustment

The Ignore Shared Exposure setting now applies to all core team players, not just soft targets — giving you more consistent draft control.

These changes should make drafting and exposure management more stable and predictable.

Happy drafting! 🏈

notes.title: Small Companion Update with 1.01T
notes.notes: RBs will never be picked more than WRs initially as a goal in any strategy.

notes.title: Huddle Genius – Version 1.01t Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.01t is here with smarter targeting and smoother drafting performance:

Improved end-of-round targeting logic – especially for picks 1–3 and 9–12 – making better decisions on when to pick and allowing back-to-back target handling.

Added caching for round targets to speed up the Drafting Screen and reduce performance hiccups.

These changes should make drafting feel more natural and responsive.

Happy drafting! 🏈

notes.title: Small Update to 1.01S
notes.notes:
- Hotswap indicators are now correct.
- Added additional setting for hiding players by projection inside the newly created Imports section of Preferences.

notes.title: Huddle Genius – Version 1.01s Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.01s is live and brings several important fixes and improvements:

Soft targets and QB targets will now attempt to use the latest valid round instead of stopping at the earliest.

Hot Swap functionality is working again.

Prevented saving during the loading process, which could previously reset your settings if the program was closed irregularly.

Fixed issues with the % Draft Strategy section.

These changes should make drafting smoother and more reliable.

Happy drafting! 🏈

notes.title: Huddle Genius – Version 1.01r Update
notes.notes:
We’ve rolled out Version 1.01r with a mix of fixes and tweaks aimed at smoothing your drafting experience:

Fixed an issue where Hotswap was incorrectly flagged as valid.

Adjusted default bye week ratios – RB now at 40% and WR at 44%. (You can set these in your preferences – though we still recommend avoiding heavy bye-week overlap.)

Hotfix for Strategy Listings crashing in certain cases.

Improved round movement logic to reduce cases of skipping positional picks incorrectly.

Draft Manager can now better handle stressful draft changes without falling apart.

It’s not perfect yet, but we’re getting closer to a smoother, more reliable drafting tool.

Happy drafting! 🏈

notes.title: 1.01Q - Simple HotFix
notes.notes: This is a simple hotfix to address picking a quarterback, manually, out of order. We will rework our Quarterback targets if you do this. This only happens if you use the "SEARCH" option when selecting a quarterback that is not on your list. It is still highly advised to avoid this.

notes.title: 📢 Huddle Genius – Version 1.01p Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.01p delivers important fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and powerful new draft strategies!

🛠 Major Fixes & Improvements

Glitch Fixed: Resolved a major issue when re-rolling strategies, ensuring smoother and more reliable draft planning.

Better Click Targeting: Expanded the clickable area in Draft Manager for Genius Picks, making selection more intuitive and precise.

Draft smarter, click easier, and start with a winning plan.

notes.title: 📢 Huddle Genius – Version 1.01n Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.01n brings smarter sorting, improved targeting, and a brand-new dynamic QB feature!

🆕 Smarter Tier + Low Exposure Sorting

When Tier + Low Exposure is selected for Prioritize Reach, the system now sorts by lowest exposure instead of falling back to ADP in mixed-position scenarios.

This keeps your picks fresh and exposure balanced even when Genius Picks spans multiple positions.

🎯 Improved Soft Target Population

Better logic for filling your soft targets, ensuring your draft plan stays on track as the board changes.

🏈 QB Hot Swapping

Added inside the Stacking section.

Dynamically swap QBs based on your early picks—perfect for adapting your stacks on the fly!

Smarter picks, sharper stacks, and more control.
Happy drafting!
– The Huddle Genius Team

notes.title: 📢 Huddle Genius – Version 1.01m Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.01m brings new tools and smarter options to help you draft like a pro!

🆕 New Strategy: Blank Slate

Draft with ZERO positional restrictions.

No preset round-by-round structure—just pure drafting freedom.

Often results in balanced rosters while remaining truly random.

⚙️ Revamped Preferences

Cleaner, more logical organization so you can find the settings you need faster.

🏈 New Stacking Option

Prioritize Core Teamstack is now available inside Stacking settings, letting you push key team stacks to the top of your priority list.

📊 New Reach Priority Mode

Added Tier + Low Exposure setting for reach priority, blending tier-based logic with your exposure management.

Happy drafting, and may your stacks be strong!
– The Huddle Genius Team

notes.title: Huddle Genius 1.01k Update – Team Synergy Report, ADP Fixes
notes.notes:
We’ve just shipped update 1.01k of Huddle Genius, and it brings some helpful quality-of-life changes and a brand new report to level up your drafting strategy.

🆕 New: Team Synergy Report
Inside the Insights > Analysis section, you’ll now find the Team Synergy Report – a brand new way to understand your most common team stacks. This report highlights which pairs of NFL teams most frequently appear together across your rosters (requires at least 2 players from 2 different teams). Great for tracking your stacking patterns!

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements
Loading Feedback: When generating draft targets (which can sometimes take a few seconds), you’ll now see a proper loading message so you're not left guessing.

ADP Sorting Fix: We’ve resolved a bug where forced ADP picks weren’t properly sorted. They now follow the correct order as expected.

More polish and customization features are on the way soon. As always, thanks for supporting Huddle Genius and happy drafting!

notes.title: Huddle Genius – Update 1.01j Now Live!
notes.notes:
This update brings powerful new tools to help you draft smarter and manage your exposures with more precision than ever.

🔍 New: Drafted As Report (Exposure-Insights)
Get deeper insights into your player usage with the Drafted As Report, found in the Exposure-Insights section. This feature breaks down each player's value based on where you are drafting them in your lineup—exposing trends like which players are anchoring your builds and which are commonly filling in late.

⚙️ New: QB/TE3 Probabilities
Inside the Preferences tab, you can now set your own odds of drafting a:

Third Quarterback

Third Tight End

Both default to 50%, but now you have full control based on your build preferences.

🛠️ Small Tweak – Smarter Soft Target Suggestions
When “Ignore Shared Exposure” is enabled for soft targets, we’ll now also apply this to similar players shown in the ADP-based recommendation list if that round is targeting a soft target.

notes.title: 🧠 Huddle Genius 1.01g Update — Smarter, Sharper, More Accurate!
notes.notes:
As the Best Ball season ramps up, Huddle Genius continues to evolve to give you the edge you need. Version 1.01g brings quality-of-life improvements, visual polish, and a key fix to one of our most powerful strategies.

🎨 Draft Room GUI Polish
Player positions in the Draft Room are now color-coded to match the Genius Picks — making your draft board cleaner and easier to follow at a glance.

🏈 Elite QB Strategy Fix
Previously, the Elite QB Strategy wasn’t properly rotating quarterback selections, leading to repetitive outcomes. That’s now been fixed — quarterback targets now rotate as expected, bringing back the flexibility and variance you need.

🎵 New Music from Stimmerman
We’ve added 10 new original background music tracks by Stimmerman to enhance your draft atmosphere. Whether you're grinding or relaxing, the vibes are now even better.

notes.title: Huddle Genius Update - Version 1.01f Now Live!
notes.notes:
🏈 Smarter QB Soft Targeting
We've enhanced how quarterbacks are selected by running multiple iterations to ensure better alignment with your team stack settings. This improves overall stack synergy and prevents early QB picks without proper support.

⚠️ Important Note:
Make sure your soft target minimums for teams are set appropriately. Setting this value too high (like 3 or more) can lead to QBs being removed due to insufficient teammates. We recommend:

1 or 2 as the default for most teams

0 for teams where you're comfortable drafting a solo QB

As always, thank you for supporting Huddle Genius! More updates are coming as Best Ball season rolls forward.

notes.title: 🔧 Halas Update 1.01e – Small Fixes, Smoother Experience
notes.notes:
This update brings a few targeted improvements based on community feedback:

🛠️ Fixes & Tweaks

Exposure filtering has been adjusted: invalid players in a draft will no longer break exposure calculations.

When multiple positions exist for a player, sorting will now prioritize ADP instead of tier — for a more consistent draft view.

The scrolling news ticker at the bottom of the screen will no longer reload continuously, which should resolve performance hiccups related to it.

Thanks for helping us refine Halas! Your feedback is always welcome as we continue to improve during Best Ball season. More updates coming soon!

notes.title: 📢 Halas Version 1.01d is Live — Our Biggest Update Yet! 🏈🔥
notes.notes:
As we charge into August and Best Ball draft season hits full stride, Halas is leveling up in a big way. Version 1.01d brings major enhancements to the Draft Manager, Team customization, and overall usability. Let’s dive in:

Navigate to Teams under the Players section to configure individual team rules:

Adjust your exposure modifier

Control the maximum number of players you want to draft from a given team

This feature gives you fine-tuned control to align with your personal stacking strategy and risk tolerance.

Stacking is now more intelligent and better aligned with your tier strategy.

Improved flow and responsiveness in the Draft Manager.

Numerous quality-of-life tweaks to make your drafting smoother and more intuitive.

🚀 Whether you’re grinding dozens of entries or building a single masterpiece, Halas 1.04d is ready to help you dominate Best Ball season.

Thanks for being part of the Halas community — more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Halas 1.01c Release
notes.notes:
Hey Draft Masters,

Today’s update brings powerful new insights to the Draft Manager and Analysis sections — giving you better visibility into exposure limits and how unique your teams really are.
[hr][/hr]
🔍 Shared Exposure Hover Preview

When hovering over a player in the Draft Manager, you’ll now see which players are hiding or being hidden by exposure limits.

This makes it dramatically easier to understand why certain players are missing from your suggestions — and how shared exposure is shaping your draft strategy.

🎯 New: Uniqueness Score

Once you’ve completed 10 or more drafts, the Draft Manager will display a Uniqueness Score for your current team — graded from F to A+.

This grade tells you how unique your current team is compared to your own draft history — helping you build lineups that stand out in the field.

📊 New: Uniqueness Report (Insights → Analysis)

Also new: a full Uniqueness Report under Insights → Analysis, showing a side-by-side view of all your drafted teams and their associated uniqueness scores.

Requires at least 10 completed drafts to activate.

notes.title: Patch Notes – Draft Logging Improvements (v1.01.b)
notes.notes:
A small but important update has been added to improve draft logging transparency. The system now provides more detailed insights into:

✅ Why certain players are filtered from the final draft candidate list

🎯 How soft targeting works, including what factors influenced player prioritization

These enhancements should make it easier to understand the logic behind your draft advisor’s decisions and help you fine-tune your strategy with confidence.

More updates coming soon!

notes.title: 🏈 Halas v1.01 Update – Draft Manager Overhaul, New Music, Live Ticker, and More
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just pushed Version 1.01 of Huddle Genius, and it’s a big quality-of-life update focused on polish, readability, and improved draft logic!
[hr][/hr]✨ Draft Manager Revamp
The Draft Manager GUI has been completely overhauled for a smoother and more intuitive experience. Navigation is cleaner, information is easier to digest, and the interface now better reflects real-time draft logic and strategy shifts.
[hr][/hr]🎶 New Music Tracks Added
We’ve added 10 new tracks to the in-app music rotation, giving your draft sessions more variety and atmosphere. Whether you’re deep in concentration or just vibing between picks, the new playlist sets the tone.

Across the app, we’ve updated and refined text elements to better highlight player positions using color coding. This makes reading through tiers, exposures, and player lists quicker and more visually distinct.

notes.title: 🎉 Huddle Genius Update – Soundtrack, New Reports, Strategies, and Influencers
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve been hard at work improving Huddle Genius ahead of our public launch later this month, and we’re excited to roll out some big new features in this update!
[hr][/hr]🎵 New: Official Huddle Genius Soundtrack
Your war room just got a vibe upgrade. Huddle Genius now includes an original in-app soundtrack designed to keep your mind focused and your draft flowing. Whether you’re on the clock or deep in analysis, enjoy a curated audio experience built for Best Ball domination.
[hr][/hr]📊 More Reports: Positional Breakdown Added
Want to know how your exposure breaks down by position? We've added a brand-new Positional Breakdown Report to the Insights Dashboard. Quickly assess how heavily you're leaning into each position across your drafts to balance (or embrace) your strategy.
[hr][/hr]🧠 New Draft Strategy: The Double Punt
Introducing the Double Punt — a bold strategy that fades both the Quarterback and Tight End positions until the late rounds. This high-upside, high-variance approach opens up your early draft capital for high-ceiling RBs and WRs. The strategy is now available in the Draft Room Advisor.
[hr][/hr]🔄 New Feature: Reroll Strategy at Draft Start
Not feeling your preloaded game plan? You can now reroll your strategy right at the start of the draft with a single click. Huddle Genius will instantly generate a new optimized strategy path while still respecting your overall exposures and constraints.
[hr][/hr]📨 Influencer Access Coming Soon
Starting shortly, we’ll begin sending out Steam CD keys to select fantasy football creators, analysts, and streamers. If you run a fantasy football platform, livestream, or podcast and want to feature your rankings inside Huddle Genius, reach out! We’d love to get you set up before launch.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks again for all your support as we prepare for the official launch this month. More exciting features are on the way—stay tuned!

notes.title: 📊 Major Update: Introducing the Insights Section!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce a huge new feature—Insights is here! This powerful new section brings a suite of visual and table-based reports that dive deeper into your Best Ball exposure than ever before.

🏈 Want to see how many players you have from each NFL team? Done.

⏱ Curious how many players you drafted before Round 6? It's there.

📁 Personalized Tiers: Now with Folder Support

You now have better control over which tier set you're using—especially helpful if you’ve got different lists for Underdog, DraftKings, or personal variations. Easily switch between them and stay organized as you fine-tune your draft strategy.

More enhancements are on the way—stay tuned and keep stacking smart. 💡

notes.title: 🎯 New Update: ADP Precision + Smarter Exposure Handling! 🎯
notes.notes:
🆕 ADP Pick Logic Enhanced

The ADP-based picks setting now uses actual pick numbers instead of flat rounds.

This means if you want Pick 1.01 to always draft ADP #1 (and not float loosely based on round), you can lock it in precisely.

Perfect for making sure you always grab your cornerstone player when they’re supposed to go!
[hr][/hr]
🔗 Shared Exposure Setting: Low / Average / High
You now have 3 ways to calculate shared exposure when managing player combinations:

Low – Uses the exposure rate of the least-drafted player in the pair.

High – Uses the exposure rate of the most-drafted player in the pair.

Average – Takes the average exposure rate across both players.

This gives you complete control over how aggressively you want to limit player pairings. Whether you want tight stacking limits or just a broad safety net, it's now up to you.
[hr][/hr]
As always, thank you for the feedback and keep building those winning rosters! 💪

— The Huddle Genius Team 🧠🏈

notes.title: Update Available – New Help Section, Smoother Fonts, and Generated Exposures
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’ve just rolled out a quality-of-life update focused on making Huddle Genius easier to use, more readable, and more compatible with additional draft platforms. Here's what’s new:
[hr][/hr]📘 Brand New Help Section
Lost? Confused? Just want to learn something new?
The new in-app Help Section is now live! You’ll find step-by-step instructions, screenshots, and guidance on setting up rankings, importing exposures, and more — all from within the app.
[hr][/hr]🔤 Anti-Aliased Fonts
Say goodbye to jagged edges!
We've upgraded the font rendering throughout the application to use anti-aliasing, making all text smoother and easier to read. Your eyes will thank you.

Drafting on a site that doesn’t support exporting exposures? No problem.
Huddle Genius now creates exposure .csv files automatically after every draft (outside of Auto-Sim mode). You can choose to use them directly or move them into your main exposure folder — perfect for tracking drafts from platforms like ESPN or Yahoo.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks for your continued support — and good luck with your drafts!
Let us know if you run into any issues or want to suggest new features. 🏈

— The Huddle Genius Team

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Update: Smarter Importing, Faster Loading, and Better Targeting
notes.notes:
Hey managers! We’ve just rolled out a quality-of-life patch that smooths out some core functionality and improves how your picks and targets behave behind the scenes.
🧠 Importing Improvements
Tier Importing Made Foolproof – The importer now explains your tier headers more clearly and handles lists that are actually ADP rankings in disguise, applying the logic automatically.
🎯 Targeting Tweaks
Soft Targeting Logic Overhaul – We now properly account for positional counts when applying soft targeting (like preferred WR or RB reach).

Round 18 Now Included – Late-round target logic now properly applies through to the final round.

Smarter Soft Targets – Refined how the system handles and evaluates soft target lists for better drafting accuracy.
⚡ Performance & UI
Faster Pick Generation – Draft pick generation now runs quicker, with a loading notifier so you’re never left wondering what’s happening.

Thanks again for all your feedback – more updates coming soon as we fine-tune the experience for Best Ball dominance.

See you in the draft room!
– The Dev Team

notes.title: 🛠 Update: Matchup Targeting, QB Customization & Bye Week Tools!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've rolled out a quality-of-life update focused on customization and clarity, giving you more control over your draft strategy and better insight into your picks. Here's what's new:
[hr][/hr]🔍 Matchup Week Customization
You can now configure which weeks the app considers for potential matchup stacks! Use the in-app GUI tools under Settings to fine-tune the matchup targeting window to your preference (e.g., Weeks 16-17 only). This helps you identify high-value game stacks when it matters most.
[hr][/hr]🎯 Soft Targeting Customization for QBs + Pass Catchers
We've introduced new sliders to let you customize:

Safety Buffer – how closely you want to target a player's average draft position (ADP).

Reach Range – how far you're willing to stretch to grab a QB or a potential stack.

This makes the soft targeting system more flexible and suited to your playstyle and tolerance for risk.
[hr][/hr]🧠 Bye Week Helper Window
Understanding your positional limits just got easier. The Bye Week panel now includes a small info window that breaks down:

Desired roster counts per position (in green)

How many players you’ve taken with the same bye week (in blue)

This math-based helper makes sure you’re never left guessing how close you are to your limits.
[hr][/hr]
— The Dev Team 🏈
